description: This file defines a mock implementation of the TokenStorageInterface used for CSRF tokens in testing scenarios. It provides methods to set, get, check, and remove tokens, storing them internally in an array.

classes.name: ArrayCsrfTokenStorage
classes.description: A mock token storage class for CSRF tokens used in testing, implementing TokenStorageInterface.

methods.name: getToken
methods.description: Retrieves a CSRF token by its ID, throws TokenNotFoundException if not found.

methods.name: setToken
methods.description: Stores a CSRF token with the given ID.

methods.name: removeToken
methods.description: Removes a token by its ID and returns it if exists; does nothing if token does not exist.

methods.name: hasToken
methods.description: Checks if a token with the given ID exists in storage.
